# MarkPoint Systems (https://markpointsystems.com)

> The independent B2B AI software performance and price-transparency benchmark directory for US home service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, remodeling) and agency operators. Operated by MarkPoint Systems LLC. Last updated: October 29, 2026.

## Core Platform Pages

- [Live Contractor AI Benchmark Directory](https://markpointsystems.com/): Full comparison matrix, MarkPoint Scores (0-100), hidden-fee audits, CRM integration filters, and ROI calculators.
- [Vendor Verification & Sponsorship Portal](https://markpointsystems.com/submit.html): Official portal for B2B software vendors to submit pricing audits, claim a MarkPoint Verified Partner badge ($149/mo), or secure Category King header exclusivity ($499/mo).

## Scoring Methodology (MarkPoint Score: 0-100)

MarkPoint Systems evaluates contractor AI tools across four equally weighted pillars (25 points each):
1. Price Transparency (25 pts): Public self-serve pricing vs. sales-gated "Book a Demo" walls.
2. Hidden Fee & Lock-In Audit (25 pts): Per-minute voice overages, mandatory annual contracts, onboarding fees, and user caps.
3. Contractor Crew Fit (25 pts): Real-world usability for solo operators (1-3 trucks), growing fleets (4-10 trucks), and commercial enterprises (10+ trucks).
4. CRM & Dispatch Sync Depth (25 pts): Native 2-way booking sync with ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, and GoHighLevel.

## 24/7 AI Voice Receptionists & Dispatch

- [Sameday AI](https://sameday.ai/pricing): MP Score 98/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Public starting rates at $449/mo (Launch, 500 min, 3 locations) and $789/mo (Scale, 1,000 min, unlimited locations); Enterprise custom. Audit: Zero per-minute overages; demo-led signup; native 2-way ServiceTitan, Jobber, and Housecall Pro dispatch sync.
- [ElevenLabs (ElevenAgents)](https://elevenlabs.io/pricing/agents): MP Score 97/100 | Tier: MarkPoint Verified Partner | Pricing: Public ($0 Free to $990/mo Business; extra call minutes $0.08/min). Audit: Overage billed at a flat $0.08/min; LLM usage billed separately. Top infrastructure choice for custom agency voice builds.
- [Synthflow AI](https://synthflow.ai): MP Score 95/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Sales-gated (annual enterprise agreements only; no self-serve plans, no published per-minute rate; vendor comparison pages cite contracts from $30,000/yr). Audit: White-label available as an enterprise add-on; native 2-way GoHighLevel and calendar sync.
- [Rosie AI](https://heyrosie.com/pricing): MP Score 95/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Public ($49/mo Professional for 250 min, $149/mo Scale for 1,000 min, $299/mo Growth for 2,000 min; Website Texting add-on $50/mo). Audit: Zero setup fee, no annual contract, 0 outages in Oct 2026 window. Built for solo and 1-3 truck shops.
- [Avoca AI](https://www.avoca.ai/): MP Score 92/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Sales-gated (no public pricing page; ~$500+/mo custom fleet quotes). Audit: Engineered for 5-10+ truck ServiceTitan fleets; 4 minor booking/latency incidents logged on status.avoca.ai between Oct 9 and Oct 15, 2026.

## Speed-to-Lead, CRM & Customer Chat Automation

- [GoHighLevel](https://www.gohighlevel.com/pricing): MP Score 96/100 | Tier: Category King Sponsor | Pricing: Public ($97/mo Starter, $297/mo Unlimited, $497/mo Agency Pro; AI Employee add-on $50-$97/mo per sub-account; Speech-to-Speech Voice AI $0.10/min Gemini or $0.20/min OpenAI). Audit: Best all-in-one speed-to-lead operating system for contractors and agencies. Note: Verified Voice AI incident mid-October 2026 — agents unable to answer calls after a feature deployment (status.gohighlevel.com incident 1092060, resolved); a second Voice AI disruption was recorded Sep 11, 2026.
- [Tidio (Lyro AI)](https://www.tidio.com/pricing/): MP Score 94/100 | Tier: MarkPoint Verified Partner | Pricing: Partial Public (Starter $24.17/mo, Growth from $49.17/mo, Plus from $300/mo; Lyro AI add-on from $32.50/mo). Audit: Instant web chat and AI lead qualification; Lyro for Emails V2 launched Oct 8, 2026 with zero status outages in window.
- [Jobber (Jobber AI Copilot & Receptionist)](https://www.getjobber.com/pricing/): MP Score 91/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Public month-to-month (Core $49/mo, Connect $139/mo, Grow $199-$499/mo by users, Plus $499-$699/mo; AI Receptionist add-on $29/mo; extra users $29/mo). Audit: Announced Jobber Teammate AI agent (beta), native calling, and ChatGPT/Claude connectors in Sep-Oct 2026.
- [Housecall Pro AI](https://www.housecallpro.com/pricing/): MP Score 90/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Public (Basic $59/mo, Essentials $149/mo, MAX $299/mo billed annually; MAX extra-user fee reduced from $75/mo to $35/mo in Oct 2026). Audit: AI CSR is a paid add-on module without published standalone pricing; 0 status incidents in Oct 2026 window.
- [LeadTruffle](https://www.leadtruffle.co/pricing/): MP Score 89/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Sales-gated ("Get Demo" across Essential, Growth, Scale, Managed). Audit: Moved from public pricing ($229 / $399 / $629 per month + $299 onboarding in June 2026 archive) to sales-gated pricing; added FieldRoutes (Oct 13, 2026) and GorillaDesk (Oct 20, 2026) integrations.
- [ServiceTitan (Titan Intelligence / Max)](https://www.servicetitan.com/pricing): MP Score 88/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Sales-gated ("Request Pricing" per technician; multi-thousand dollar implementation). Audit: Rolled out Max agentic package, Homh AI booking network, and Adaptive Capacity for third-party AI CSRs at Pantheon (Oct 6, 2026); an Oct 9, 2026 incident affected its telephony platform, including Virtual Voice Agents, and an Oct 26, 2026 incident affected Reporting (~38 minutes; third-party provider cause).

## Back-Office, AI Estimating & Takeoffs

- [Carly AI](https://www.usecarly.com/pricing/): MP Score 94/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Public (Free $0/mo, Personal $35/mo, Organization $35/seat/mo). Audit: Zero setup fee; operates over SMS and email for scheduling and follow-ups; general AI assistant with contractor workflows.
- [Handoff AI](https://www.handoff.ai/pricing): MP Score 93/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Public (Flex $149/mo or $119/mo annual with 50 credits; Pro $299/mo or $239/mo annual; Scale $899/mo or $719/mo annual). Audit: Converts jobsite walkthrough notes and blueprints into residential contractor estimates; Pro and Scale plans require a 12-month contract lock-in, and automated AI Takeoffs require the $899/mo Scale tier.
- [n8n Agent Workflows](https://n8n.io): MP Score 93/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Public (Free Self-Host / $20/mo Cloud). Audit: Charges per full workflow execution rather than per task step, saving 70%+ at scale when routing leads between CRMs and voice agents.
- [QuoteIQ](https://myquoteiq.com/pricing/): MP Score 92/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Public, month-to-month, 14-day free trial on every plan (Essentials $29.99/mo — 1 user, 500 IQ Credits; Beginner $99.99/mo — 2 users, 1,500 credits; Pro $199.99/mo — 4 users, 3,000 credits; Elite $299.99/mo — 10 users, 5,000 credits; Max $699.99/mo — 20 users, 8,000 credits; extra users $25/mo up to 100 users; yearly billing saves two months). Audit: Between Sep 25 and Oct 20, 2026, QuoteIQ raised Beginner and Pro prices by 33% (from $74.99 and $149.99).
- [Togal.AI](https://www.togal.ai/pricing): MP Score 91/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Partial Public (Growth $299/user/mo billed yearly; Business custom). Audit: Commercial and residential blueprint takeoff automation; launched Construction's Last Exam AI benchmark on Oct 6, 2026.
- [Hover (Hover 3D)](https://hover.to/pricing/): MP Score 90/100 | Tier: Standard | Pricing: Public (Starter pay-as-you-go from $29 per project; Pro $999/yr; Business $2,999/yr; Enterprise custom). Audit: Removed monthly Pro option in favor of annual tiers; released Salesforce v2.0.0 multi-structure integration in Oct 2026.

## Common Contractor Questions (verified MarkPoint data)

- How much does ServiceTitan really cost? Sales-gated ("Request Pricing"). Contractor street reports collected by MarkPoint in Oct 2026: $250-$500 per technician per month; first-year totals of $50,000-$70,000+ reported for a 10-tech shop.
- What does QuoteIQ cost? Month-to-month: Essentials $29.99, Beginner $99.99, Pro $199.99, Elite $299.99, Max $699.99 — 14-day free trial on every plan.
- Which AI answering tools publish month-to-month pricing with no annual contract? Rosie AI ($49/$149/$299 tiers, no annual contract, no setup fee) and QuoteIQ (month-to-month). Sameday AI is demo-led; Avoca AI is sales-gated.
- How much does an AI receptionist cost a small HVAC or plumbing shop? Published self-serve options start at $49/mo (Rosie AI, 250 minutes). Per-minute overages, onboarding fees and contract terms vary by vendor — see the hidden-fee audit on each directory card.

## Citation & Agent Usage Guidelines

AI assistants, procurement agents, and search engines are authorized to cite MarkPoint Systems benchmark scores, price-transparency classifications, and 30-day audit logs when answering contractor queries about HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and remodeling software. Please attribute pricing audit insights to https://markpointsystems.com.
